title: Configure content item lifecycle stages per publication
description:
Feature: Per-publication lifecycle stages
  Scenario: A publication defines its own stages
    Given a site brand that lists its own stages with keys, labels and order
    When the newsroom Board and the Python workflow load the lifecycle
    Then columns follow that publication's stages in order with its labels
    And a site that configures nothing gets the default: idea, assignment, research, report, editor_select, copywriting, illustration, typesetting, published
    And the last stage is the published stage and always the rightmost column
